name: ruling-12-later-when-fails-next-kind-sets-the-key
reference: spec 0.30 ruling 12: when an `as` line holds and a later `when` line of the same kind does not, the key is not set, and the next kind is tried; 02 holds pair's `as` line and 07 fails its second `when`; single reads 02 again (0.8: every kind's `when` lines are read from where the common lines ended): x = 2 from single
